messages:
Alex Chen: Quick async check-in. Launched a small canary for per-route token-smoothing on the API gateway to tame short, bursty clients causing 429s. What I did: implemented bucket smoothing math, hooked metrics, and set canary=alpha label. Blockers: noticed p95 coldstart increase on a Dedicated pool variant under burst; looks like warmup isn't firing early enough. Plan: monitor for 2h and trigger prewarm to 30% traffic if 429s don't improve.

Priya Rao: Saw ~03:40 UTC spike of 502s on /v1/generate correlated with auth refresh retries. Merged auth client backoff + jitter in PR #4812. Can we make retries prefer secondary auth region during canary? Will reduce quota storming.

Samir Patel: Reproduced the p95 coldstart in staging. Adding an activation prewarm hook reduces p95 by ~120ms. I'll open PR #4813 to add the hook and a REDWOOD_PREWARM env var (default true). Low-risk change.

Jordan M: Need the metric queries for the new dashboard panel. Looking for p95 latency, 429/sec, and auth_error_rate per-route, filtered to canary.

Alex Chen: Use these PromQLs (use canary=alpha label):

```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="gateway",route="/v1/generate",canary="alpha"}[5m])) by (le))
sum by (route) (increase(redwood_http_429_total{canary="alpha"}[5m]))
sum by (route) (increase(redwood_auth_error_total{canary="alpha"}[5m]))
```

I'll add a temp alert: any route 429_rate > 6/min for 10m -> pager.

InfraBot: autoscaler: scaled +2 instances to pool-dedicated-us-west-2 at 2025-03-04T07:12:15Z (trigger: cpu>70% sustained). link: https://infra.example/scale/67890

Maya Singh: Deployed a short-lived rate-limiter tweak for /v1/embeddings: doubled refill tokens for a 6-hour smoothing window to absorb known spikes. Watching cost impact; will revert if unit cost jumps. @Priya I didn't change auth path.

Priya Rao: Confirmed auth quota checks still run on retries. I'll add lightweight smoke checks to the canary job to exercise auth+generate and post results here.

Samir Patel: Found a race in KV cache invalidation during concurrent invalidate + serve. Short patch in PR #4814:

```
if (!invalidation_in_progress.test_and_set()) {
  kvcache.invalidate(prefix);
  invalidation_in_progress.clear();
}
```

Could explain occasional stale-prefix hits.

Alex Chen: Summary: Monitor canary metrics (p95, 429s, auth errors), Samir to ship prewarm + race fix PRs, Maya's refill tweak active for embeddings, infra scaled. If 429s not reduced in 2h, expand canary and route retries to secondary auth region. :thumbsup:

Jordan M: Will add dashboard panels + short oncall runbook note.

Priya Rao: Smoke tests being added to the canary pipeline; will post pass/fail in this thread.

Alex Chen: Thanks team — post here for any urgent regressions. :coffee:
